title: 第25章 正妻放话 纳妾一个不够第26章 麒麟儿要逆天啊老李家要问鼎
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 李长生和江翠萍也睡不着。
江翠萍侧着身子，小手搭在李长生的胸口，感受着丈夫有力的心跳。
江翠萍：“你是不是有什么事瞒着我？”
李长生闻言，眼睛躲闪：“不是已经告诉你了吗？关于两个孩子的。”
江翠萍：“我问的不是这个。”
李长生摇了摇头：“那就没有了。”
江翠萍打断李长生的话：“不。你有。”
这时江翠萍淡淡的声音又传过来了：“你也别想瞒我。我们当夫妻那么多年了，你眨个眼睛，我就知道你在想什么。你撅起屁股，我就知道你要放屁。”
江翠萍的声音越来越低，嘴唇带着一丝颤抖。
最后仿佛用尽全身力气才问出了一句：
“是不是因为我生不出孩子？想纳妾了？”
虽然我什么都没有说，你却能一言猜中。
但被江翠萍猜中了之后。
李长生却越发不知道该如何开口了。
纳妾对于修仙者来说，真的算不了什么。
因为修仙者能够活很久很久。
修仙者的须臾之间，或许已经是凡人的一辈子。
江翠萍见李长生沉默，顿时肯定了心头的想法。爬过来，压在李长生胸膛，纤纤玉手在不停地画圈圈。
李长生想了想，没有否认。
还是要跟江翠萍好好谈一谈。
content_en:
…
It's late at night.
Ningning and Pingping couldn't sleep.
Li Changsheng and Jiang Cuiping couldn't sleep either.
Li Changsheng was lying on the bed.
Jiang Cuiping leaned sideways and put her small hands on Li Changsheng's chest, feeling her husband's strong heartbeat.
Jiang Cuiping: "Husband."
Li Changsheng: "Huh?"
Jiang Cuiping: "Are you hiding something from me?"
When Li Changsheng heard this, his eyes dodged: "Didn't I tell you already? About the two children."
Jiang Cuiping: "That's not what I asked."
Li Changsheng shook his head: "Then no."
Jiang Cuiping interrupted Li Changsheng: "No. You do."
Li Changsheng: "..."
At this time, Jiang Cuiping's faint voice came again: "Don't try to hide it from me. We have been husband and wife for so many years. If you blink your eyes, I will know what you are thinking. If you stick your butt up, I will know that you are going to fart."
"You've been waking up in the middle of the night for the past two years."
"Then he kept tossing me."
"It seems like she really wants a child."
Talking and talking.
Jiang Cuiping's voice became lower and lower, with a hint of trembling on her lips.
Finally, as if he had exhausted all his strength, he asked:
"Is it because I can't give birth to a child? Do you want to take a concubine?"
When Li Changsheng heard this, he fell silent.
yes!
Really understands me.
Although I didn't say anything, you could guess it right.
But after being guessed by Jiang Cuiping.
But Li Changsheng didn't know how to speak anymore.
Life is only a few autumns.
Taking concubines is really nothing to a cultivator.
Because cultivators can live for a long, long time.
A moment for a cultivator may be a lifetime for a mortal.
Do you really want to take a concubine?
Um.
Must take concubines.
Seeing Li Changsheng's silence, Jiang Cuiping immediately confirmed her thoughts. He crawled over and pressed on Li Changsheng's chest, while his slender hands kept drawing circles.
"I knew it."
"I guessed it right, right?"
Li Changsheng thought for a while and did not deny it.
He must take a concubine.
Otherwise, you can only wait to die.
So...
We still need to have a good talk with Jiang Cuiping.
Try to get the forgiveness of your first wife.
Um?
title_en: Chapter 25 The head wife said that one concubine is not enough. Chapter 26 Qilin'er wants to defy the heavens and the old Li family wants to win the championship.
